actions.label: Verify startup persistence and foreground launch

reproduce.title: Test Win+Y and Alt+Y calc launches after restart
prerequisites: Current upstream main or build containing PR #49571
steps: Configure Win+Y and Alt+Y as Run Program shortcuts targeting calc.exe.
Restart/sign back in without changing Keyboard Manager settings and invoke both shortcuts.
Repeat while another application is foregrounded and record whether calc.exe becomes the foreground window.
If a shortcut fails, toggle Keyboard Manager once and repeat to distinguish startup initialization from launch routing.
reproduce.expected_result: Both mappings continue to launch calc.exe after restart, and the launched calculator appears in the foreground as configured.
